Rules.InvariantScript:
Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.DeviceName, "") & "   |   " &
 CountRows(Filter(colAssetTimeline, Kind = "Move")) & " moves" &
 "   |   " & CountRows(Filter(colAssetTimeline, Kind = "Issue")) & " issues" &
 "   |   " & CountRows(Filter(colAssetTimeline, Kind = "Booking")) & " bookings"

Sort(
    Filter(
        colAssetTimeline,
        varHistFilter = "All"
            || Kind = varHistFilter
            || (varHistFilter = "Issue" && Kind = "Resolved")
            || (varHistFilter = "Move" && Kind = "Handover")
    ),
    SortKey,
    SortOrder.Descending
)

Switch(
    ThisItem.Kind,
    "Move", RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1),
    "Handover",   RGBA(0, 90, 158, 1),
    "Issue",      RGBA(196, 89, 17, 1),
    "Resolved",     RGBA(16, 124, 16, 1),
    "Booking",   RGBA(122, 60, 190, 1),
    "Maintenance",    RGBA(0, 153, 153, 1),
    RGBA(161, 159, 157, 1)
)

Switch(
    ThisItem.Kind,
    "Move", RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1),
    "Handover",   RGBA(0, 90, 158, 1),
    "Issue",      RGBA(196, 89, 17, 1),
    "Resolved",     RGBA(16, 124, 16, 1),
    "Booking",   RGBA(122, 60, 190, 1),
    "Maintenance",    RGBA(0, 153, 153, 1),
    RGBA(96, 94, 92, 1)
)

If(
    varHistFilter = "All",
    "Nothing has been recorded for this asset yet.",
    "No events of this type for this asset."
)
